newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Coltabaco cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Coltabaco cut to hold.

text.p: ING Barings said it had downgraded Colombia's Coltabaco from buy to hold because of a negative outlook for sales revenues this year.
The company, owned by the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, is Colombia's largest cigarette maker.

Alejandra Torres, ING Barings' head of Colombia equity research, said Coltabaco's sales revenues were likely to suffer from several factors including declining demand for cigarettes and "tough price competition."
She added in a statement that she had cut Coltabaco's year-end target price to $3.60 per share from a previous estimate of $4.20 ((-- Tom Brown, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
